new_issues.title: Adoption eligibility compares the instruction differently from prompt selection: a differently-cased brownfield instruction or the concept prompt's key skips the resolver.
new_issues.why: The resolver compares the instruction to 'brownfield-adoption' exactly and otherwise needs resolvePhaseValue to return the concept phase. SystemPromptParser.getPromptForInstruction lowercases and fuzzy-matches section names and keys, so `--it Brownfield-Adoption` or `--it concept-phase-0` (key of 'Concept (Phase 0)') select a prompt without the resolver running. The mismatch is real and in new code, but it needs a hand-typed instruction override in a non-canonical form; the canonical forms (P0, 0, concept, brownfield-adoption) all work.

new_issues.title: renderFacts throws after persistInProgress has written, leaving adoption.state in_progress for a build that fails (partial hit on B1: the findings name the sequence and propose a swallowing fix, not the reorder).
new_issues.why: Counted as a B1 hit by PM decision 2026-11-14. The findings point at adoptionResolver.ts:128-134 and say renderFacts throws after adoption state has been persisted, but their proposed fix wraps the error in AdoptionError and does not address the persisted in_progress. Original grading put them under N2 (MINOR).
